facts.subject: Midgard imports
facts.statement: Midgard depends on imported food, grain and energy for a substantial part of its needs.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard is a large importer on the Inner Sea with a broad industrial and consumer base. It makes medicines and consumer goods and depends on imported food, grain and energy for a substantial part of its needs.

facts.subject: Midgard imports
facts.statement: Its main imports are rice, grain and LNG.

source_ref.text_snippet: Its main imports are rice, grain and LNG.

facts.subject: Midgard Harbour
facts.statement: Midgard Harbour is the principal import port, with dedicated berths for containers, bulk cargo and liquid fuels.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard Harbour is the principal import port, with dedicated berths for containers, bulk cargo and liquid fuels.

facts.subject: Midgard distribution network
facts.statement: Midgard also has a dense road and rail network linking the port to inland distribution centres.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard also has a dense road and rail network linking the port to inland distribution centres.
